by: claude: /research-country Luxembourg (new country), with the tax back-fill 2015 onward for the four report taxes
note: Luxembourg from nothing. One national regime (the only local tax, the municipal property tax, is not counted). Taxes from PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries (copies dated inside each year, live for 2026), EY for 2015, guichet.lu for inheritance; treaties from the MRA list and synthesised text, the SRC list and the Luxembourg Mémorial; the blacklist from the Luxembourg tax administration's own copy of the EU list; trusts from the HCCH table; millionaires from UBS 2026; employers from Eurostat (separate SQL).

jurisdictions.name: Luxembourg
jurisdictions.structure_note: One national regime: income tax (with the solidarity surcharge), capital gains, inheritance and gift duties are national. Only the municipal property tax and the municipal business tax vary by commune; they are not counted.

rates.note: Gains on shares held more than six months are not taxed unless the holding is substantial (more than 10%); held six months or less they are taxed at the progressive rates (EY Worldwide Personal Tax Guide 2015-16 (content current on 1 July 2015); no PwC copy dated in 2015 exists). The report realises gains yearly on holdings of a year, so 0.

"If movable properties are disposed of more than six months following their acquisition, capital gains are not taxed unless the individual holds an important participation (material interest)" (more than 10%); within six months they are taxed at the progressive rates up to 43.6% (PwC, last reviewed 1 Jun 2016). rates.thr_note: Deduction of up to €50,000 every ten years (doubled for joint filers).
rates.note: Main residence exempt. Other real estate: progressive rates (up to 45.78%) if sold within two years; after two years half the marginal rate, and for gains realised in 2024 a quarter of it (45.78% / 4 = 11.445%); a deduction of up to €50,000 every ten years (PwC, last reviewed 22 Aug 2024). From 2025 the speculation period is five years.

A temporary quarter rate applied to deeds signed from 1 July to 30 September 2025.

treaties.note: Treaty WHT from Mauritius: dividends 5% and 10%, interest and royalties exempt (MRA table). Signed 15 Feb 1995, protocol of 28 Jan 2014, MLI in force for Mauritius 1 Feb 2020; applicable in Luxembourg from 1 Jan 1996 (Luxembourg treaty list, Mémorial A n° 24 of 1996). Exact entry-into-force date to confirm.

Signed in Luxembourg on 4 Jun 2012; entered into force on 19 Aug 2013 (Mémorial A n° 168 of 13 Sep 2013, p. 3214); applicable from 1 Jan 2014 (Luxembourg treaty list). Listed on the SRC agreements page. Treaty WHT rates not yet read.

gates.note: Luxembourg applies the EU list of non-cooperative jurisdictions (art. 168 L.I.R., law of 10 Feb 2021; circular 168/2). Mauritius is not on the version in force from 6 Mar 2026, nor on any earlier version the tax administration lists.

gates.note: Luxembourg applies the EU list (art. 168 L.I.R., law of 10 Feb 2021). Seychelles is not on the version in force from 6 Mar 2026; it was on the versions from 27 Feb 2020 to 11 Oct 2021 and from 23 Oct 2023.

gaps.detail: The entry-into-force date of the 1995 Mauritius treaty is not stated on the MRA list, in the synthesised text or on the Luxembourg treaty list (which gives only "applicable from 1 Jan 1996").
